limitations: Host contention caused wide timing ranges; medians do not establish universal speed differences.
Key-memory charges do not include all fixed I/O buffers or total process RAM.
No cold-storage, fsync, network-filesystem, real skew-heavy or adversarial throughput claim.
Whole-process perf counters are syscall/instruction counts, not physical storage operations.

decision: Adopt explicit new_partitioned constructor as an opt-in resource strategy, preserving ordinary constructors and bytes. No table-cache pages are allocated; keys reuse their cap across partitions. Same-key-budget native Windows uncached ASN median 2399.49 ms versus 1078.17 ms at 16 partitions; timed ranges and additional spill cost are retained. Cached controls do not establish a consistent general speed win.

same_key_budget_controls.configuration: 4 MiB payload-key cap, no separate table-cache pages. Partition buffers remain additional fixed memory. Linux processes serial, followed by native Windows processes serial; no timed builds overlapped in this follow-up.
